title: Support framework-dependent (flat) AL Language extension layout
summary: AL-Go now supports framework-dependent AL Language extensions with flat internal layout by making path resolution aware of both nested and flat folder structures for altool, analyzers, and aldoc.
key_points: Get-ALTool probes nested bin/win32 or bin/linux paths first, then falls back to flat bin folder
Get-CustomAnalyzers downloads to bin/Analyzers when present, otherwise to flat bin
DownloadAlDoc resolves aldoc in nested or flat bin locations
Enables workspace compilation with marketplace-packaged VSIX files that use flat layout
Mirrors BcContainerHelper's existing dual-layout support for consistency
